AgentAuth.description: Deprecated machine-scoped authentication state returned by `sessions.agentAuth`. It carries no process generation and is preserved only for already-released SDKs.

process_state.description: Observed runtime fact. It is unknown until a current leased supervisor acknowledgement.

runtime_expires_at.description: Authoritative expiry of the current leased supervisor observation. Omitted when no runtime lease exists.

workspace_binding_id.description: Immutable canonical WorkspaceBinding selected for this AgentSession. Omitted only for legacy rows created before binding authority; never contains a private sync namespace.

workspace_generation.description: Immutable committed workspace generation selected for this AgentSession.

workspace_binding_id.description: Opaque canonical WorkspaceBinding identifier. The producer validates its authenticated Machine parent and current generation before mutation.

background.description: When true, provisioning may continue asynchronously and the 201 response may contain status creating. Omission or false preserves synchronous creation.

availability.description: Explicit Cuna observation. Support is never inferred from omission.

client_instance_id.description: Caller-stable Cuna client instance identity used for attachment fencing.

resume_handle.description: Previously issued Cuna resume handle. Omit for a new attachment generation.

capabilities.description: Complete explicit Cuna capability set. Every known capability appears exactly once with supported, unsupported, or unknown availability.

connect_token.description: One-use Cuna terminal connection token. Plaintext is never persisted and is never placed in connect_url.

connect_url.description: Secret-free Cuna WebSocket URL. It contains no token, query, fragment, provider host, or runtime identifier.

expires_at.description: Expiry of the unredeemed one-use connection grant.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp. UTC and explicit numeric offsets are accepted.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp. UTC and explicit numeric offsets are accepted.

items.description: Canonical portable relative workspace prefix. Absolute paths, traversal, control characters, backslashes, and device paths are rejected.

workspace_id.description: Public workspace identifier. Internal tenant and synchronization namespace identifiers are never accepted.

workspace_binding_id.description: Canonical WorkspaceBinding child of the public workspace in the request path.
Canonical WorkspaceBinding child of the public workspace in the request path.
